# Vydokh

> Mindful breathing and meditation web app. Free, installable PWA. No account required.

Vydokh (выдох) is a calm breathing timer for diaphragmatic breathing, box breathing (4×4), the 4-7-8 method, and alternate nostril breathing (nadi shodhana). Sessions last 5, 10, 15, or 20 minutes. Light/dark themes and color palettes inspired by water, earth, sun, and air.

## Pages

- `/` — breathing session: timer, play/stop, modes, duration, themes
- `/guide` — instructions: how to sit, diaphragmatic breathing, box 4×4, 4-7-8, nadi shodhana, with citations (Cleveland Clinic, Harvard Health, NCCIH, NHS, PMC)
